title: facebook_groups
description: Collect posts and public comments from a PUBLIC Facebook group. No Facebook account, session or cookies are used or required - this reads only what a logged-out visitor can see. A Page or profile URL is refused; use the facebook Actor for those.

target.description: The public group: a URL (https://www.facebook.com/groups/<id>) or a bare group id. A Page or profile URL is rejected rather than scraped.

max_posts.description: Ceiling on posts collected; 0 means NO CAP - take every post the public feed reaches. Matching posts are taken NEWEST first, so a date range narrower than this returns everything in it. Defaults to 1000 (~235 feed requests); an uncapped run is bounded only by what Facebook serves.

max_comments_per_post.description: Ceiling on public comments per post; 0 means NO CAP - take every comment Facebook serves. To skip comments entirely (much faster) set collect_comments to false. A post exposing fewer returns fewer - nothing is chased to reach this number, and the comment count Facebook reports is kept separate from what it actually served. Facebook's own public ceiling stops this well before a large number does (measured: 23 of 27 on one post).

include_replies.description: Also keep replies to comments. Off by default.

collect_comments.description: Collect comments at all. The comment stage is the expensive half of a run; turn it off for a posts-only scrape.

public_only.description: Always true. This Actor has no account and collects only public content; it is refused if set false rather than silently ignored.

start_date.description: Only posts on or after this date (UTC, inclusive). The date range is applied BEFORE max_posts. Note the group feed has no server-side date search, so an old window costs real paging time and may end incomplete - the result says which.

end_date.description: Only posts on or before this date (UTC, inclusive).

analyse.description: Run the Claude analysis and write the report, PDF and dashboard artifacts.

ai_prompt.description: Extra instructions for the analysis, e.g. what to focus on.
